comment: Machine-readable twin of narration-phase1f.md. `tts` is the ElevenLabs synthesis input (FliHub spelled 'Fly Hub', 1G spoken 'one-G'); `caption` keeps the correct spelling. Also used by walkthrough-1f.mjs to pace scene holds (local word-count estimate, no API).

scenes.caption: Riley's nine-hole course at Lakeside is laid out hole by hole — each one named, with Red and Blue basket positions carrying their own distances in feet. One course, two ways to play it.
scenes.tts: Riley's nine-hole course at Lakeside is laid out hole by hole — each one named, with Red and Blue basket positions carrying their own distances in feet. One course, two ways to play it.

scenes.caption: Not every event needs two rounds. Club Night plays this course as a single round at the Red positions — one round on the schedule, and no intermission in sight.
scenes.tts: Not every event needs two rounds. Club Night plays this course as a single round at the Red positions — one round on the schedule, and no intermission in sight.

scenes.caption: The FLI demonstration event plays the same nine physical holes twice: Round 1 at Red, an intermission break, then Round 2 at Blue — eighteen holes of play on a nine-hole course.
scenes.tts: The F L I demonstration event plays the same nine physical holes twice: Round one at Red, an intermission break, then Round two at Blue — eighteen holes of play on a nine-hole course.

scenes.caption: Six groups are staffed for the event. Group 1 pairs two teams and their four rostered athletes, with Casey assigned as the scorekeeper — assignments made now, so Phase 1G scoring can pick them up.
